mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 50,000 in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, which initially depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 205.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and supply chain activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals an extremely tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 10% from the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units, it signals strong residential demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500.
